experiments.name: reset-chain measurement
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 4000 --iters 300 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1077936128; vreplgr2vr.w $vr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 1088421888; vreplgr2vr.w $vr2, $r4; li.d $r5, -2124115384; li.d $r6, 1073741824' --asm 'vfdiv.s $vr0, $vr0, $vr2; vpickve2gr.w $r4, $vr0, 0; and $r4, $r4, $r5; or $r4, $r4, $r6; vreplgr2vr.w $vr0, $r4'
experiments.notes: Element-0 reset chain; the closure latency is cancelled by the calibration experiment.

experiments.name: vadd.b reset-helper baseline
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 4000 --iters 300 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1077936128; vreplgr2vr.w $vr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 1088421888; vreplgr2vr.w $vr2, $r4; li.d $r5, -2124115384; li.d $r6, 1073741824' --asm 'vadd.b $vr0, $vr0, $vr2; vpickve2gr.w $r4, $vr0, 0; and $r4, $r4, $r5; or $r4, $r4, $r6; vreplgr2vr.w $vr0, $r4'
experiments.notes: Same helper chain with vadd.b replacing the variable-latency operation.

latencies.notes: Data-dependent. Measured over 6 operand pairs; min 10 cycles at inf/inf, max 26 cycles at 3.0/7.0. The sample experiment uses the max-latency pair. Latency is derived by subtracting the same closure around vadd.b (calibration experiment).
